name: The Dawn of All
desc: Benson's companion to Lord of the World (1911): a priest wakes from a long illness into a world where the Church has triumphed and Europe has returned to the Faith, a utopia of Catholic civilization.
desc_pt: O contraponto de Benson a O Senhor do Mundo (1911): um padre desperta de uma longa doença num mundo em que a Igreja triunfou e a Europa voltou à fé, uma utopia da civilização católica.
edition: The Dawn of All (London: Hutchinson, 1911), Project Gutenberg #11626, proofread.
srcnote: Parts and chapters as printed; the numbered sections inside chapters are kept as ## headings.
